daily.restrictedBody:
<:hmm:1536247599365890139> **Hey, space explorer!**

The daily **∩oins** reward can only be claimed inside our **official server**!

<:excited:1536247579061256252> **How to join the server?**
Our official server link is available right in the **bot's bio**! Open the **∩lien** profile, click the bio link, and claim your coins daily! <:gold_coins:1536941656178298992>
